name: hovercard3
blurb: Image card with full-overlay description panel that appears on hover.
description: A card with background image that zooms on hover. A colored overlay panel slides up to reveal full description, button, and heading. Default overlay shows small header.
use_when: Feature cards, service showcases, or image galleries where comprehensive details are revealed on interaction.
avoid_when: Touch-only interfaces where persistent overlay states could obscure content or trap focus.
a11y: Description panel and CTA button are not visible by default; focus navigation depends on visibility state. Heading is semantic.
